name: ogbl-citation2: Academic Citation Network Link Prediction
description: The ogbl-citation2 dataset is a directed graph representing the academic paper citation network extracted from the Microsoft Academic Graph (MAG). It contains 2,927,963 paper nodes and 30,561,187 directed citation edges. Each node features a 128-dimensional Word2Vec feature vector extracted from paper titles and abstracts. The task is to predict missing citation links (which paper cites which paper) evaluated by Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR), partitioned chronologically: papers published until 2018 for training, 2019 for validation, and 2019 for test.
